title: Lead distribution
description: Rules that pick the owner of new records by round robin, weight, least load or the value of a field. Use them in automations ("Assign by rule" action), incoming webhooks and imports.
emptyDescription: Create a rule to distribute leads among the sales team automatically.

strategyHints.round_robin: Whoever waited longest gets the next one.
strategyHints.weighted: Each member receives in proportion to their weight (weight 3 receives three times more than weight 1).
strategyHints.least_loaded: Whoever has the fewest open deals gets the next one.

editor.description: Choose who takes part, how the next owner is picked and, optionally, routes by field value.
editor.name: Name
editor.keyHint: Stable identifier (lowercase letters, digits and _). Leave empty to derive it from the name.
editor.membersHint: Suspended users and users outside the organization are skipped automatically.
editor.awayHint: Without dates, stays away until unchecked.
editor.routingHint: Sends the record to a team or users according to a field value (e.g. region, source). The first matching route wins.
editor.routeValuesHint: Separate with commas. Case is ignored.

validation.key: Use lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
validation.memberRepeated: This user is already in the list.
validation.membersRequired: Add at least one member (or use routes without fallback distribution).
validation.awayPeriod: The end of the absence must be after its start.
validation.routeTarget: Choose a team or at least one user.

simulation.title: Simulate: {{name}}
simulation.description: See who would receive the next records from the current rotation state. Nothing is saved.
simulation.nobody: Nobody would receive: no member is available.
simulation.unassigned: No route matched and the rule leaves the record without owner.

selection.fallback: No route matched; using the rule members.

simulation.inactiveRule: The rule is inactive: the simulation shows what would happen if it were active.

confirmDelete.title: Delete the rule "{{name}}"?
confirmDelete.description: The rotation state and the assignment history will be erased. Automations, webhooks and imports using the rule stop assigning.

errors.keyTaken: Another rule already uses this key.
errors.versionConflict: Someone else changed the rule. Reload and try again.

history.title: Assignment history
history.description: Who received each distributed record, newest first.

ruleSelect.label: Distribution rule
ruleSelect.hint: When set, the rule picks the owner of each created record.
ruleSelect.empty: No active rule for this record type.
